content.question: What is the purpose of the replay buffer in Deep Q-Learning?
options: It caches the neural network weights so training can be skipped.
It stores the environment's states so the agent never revisits them.
It replaces the reward function with a learned one.
It stores the agent's experiences and trains on random mini-batches, breaking correlations between consecutive experiences and improving convergence.
content.answer: It stores the agent's experiences and trains on random mini-batches, breaking correlations between consecutive experiences and improving convergence.
